newsitem.title: USA: Alliant Techsystems gets $1.2 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Alliant Techsystems gets $1.2 mln contract.

text.p: Alliant Techsystems Inc said Thursday the U.S. Army Communications Electronics Command awarded its Power Sources Center a $1.2 million contract to develop and implement flexible manufacturing processes for lithium ion polymer batteries.

The work will be performed in conjunction with Valence Technology Inc under a recently announced joint venture called Alliant/Valence LLC. The venture will develop and manufacture batteries for the military market.

Alliant said the automated production line at its Power Sources Center will have the ability to produce efficiently a variety of battery sizes, shapes and capacities with low-switching costs, making it economical for short production runs.
Alliant Techsystems is a $1.2 billion aerospace and defense company.
